basic_info.description: Located in the heart of the vibrant Mission Dolores neighborhood, 457-461 Guerrero Street is a compelling value-add opportunity in one of San Francisco's most desirable areas. This stately 1907 Classic Revival triplex sits on an oversized 28' x 110' lot, offering a spacious backyard perfect for outdoor living. The building features three large full-floor flats - each with 4 bedrooms, a split bath, and in-unit laundry - above a garage with parking. The lower unit will be delivered vacant, ideal for an owner-user or to unlock market-rate rental potential. Original period details provide the perfect canvas for thoughtful upgrades, allowing you to enhance value while preserving historic charm. With a Walk Score of 99, residents enjoy effortless access to Dolores Park, vibrant cafes, shops, and transit. Whether you're seeking a legacy asset or a strategic investment, this property offers both character and potential.
